views.front: Image 1 is a 3D render of Anna, a fictional Brazilian jiu-jitsu brown belt competitor (not a real or famous person), standing in an A-pose. Image 2 is a close-up of her face for identity only. Redraw image 1 as a photorealistic full-body studio photograph of exactly the same woman: same face, same dark blonde hair pulled back in a tight low bun, same proportions, with the lean, strong build of an elite, world-champion-level grappler: strong shoulders, defined forearms, toned arms and powerful legs. Same outfit: plain royal blue Brazilian jiu-jitsu gi with the jacket closed and tied, matching plain royal blue gi pants, a brown belt tied at the waist, no patches, embroidery, logos, stripes or text, barefoot. POSE IS CRITICAL, copy image 1's A-pose exactly: she stands straight facing the camera, feet shoulder-width apart, and BOTH ARMS ARE STRAIGHT AND RAISED OUT TO THE SIDES at about 45 degrees from her body, like a 3D-scanning A-pose mannequin, so there is a wide gap of empty white background between each arm and her torso and the fists are far outside the hips at upper-thigh height. The arms must not hang down by her sides. Both bare hands are clenched about 60% into a firm, partly closed fist: fingers curled toward the palm, fingertips not yet pressed into the palm, thumb resting along the index finger. Expression: a pronounced, determined, confident smirk: the left corner of her closed mouth is clearly pulled up and the right corner stays level, a slight crease beside the raised corner, no teeth, steady intense eyes looking straight into the camera, brows slightly lowered. Natural skin texture and realistic muscle definition. No logos, text or graphics anywhere. Full body visible head to feet, centered, plain white background, even soft studio lighting, photorealistic, sharp focus.
